answer: A sponsor locks a 60-credit bond and seals each newcomer with an opal stamp, capped at three each. Each epoch a beacon calls renewal: the sponsor proves real work, or reputation erodes like karst, losing 5 per idle epoch. Rented sponsors fail: fraud slashes the bond and bans the sponsor for 20 epochs. First fake costs 60, the kth 60+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,556,500 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps a full share.
